🌏 International Weather Update  Philippines Flooding 🌧️

Good morning everyone,

While we’re watching the Cornish clouds roll by, our thoughts this morning turn thousands of miles away to the Philippines, where Typhoon Tino (also known as Kalmaegi) has caused severe flooding in parts of Cotcot, Liloan, Cebu. Streets have turned into rivers, with homes, businesses, and vehicles completely submerged under floodwaters after relentless downpours from the typhoon system.

🇵🇭 The Philippines has been hit hard this season, with three major typhoons since September, each bringing destructive winds, heavy rainfall, and widespread flooding. Local authorities and rescue teams are working tirelessly around the clock, helping residents evacuate and providing essential supplies to those affected. Power outages, landslides, and blocked roads have also been reported in several regions, making rescue efforts even more challenging.

💨 Typhoon Tino formed in the western Pacific, an area that often sees the birth of powerful tropical systems during this time of year due to the warm ocean temperatures that fuel their development. These storms can intensify quickly, leaving communities little time to prepare a sobering reminder of the strength of nature.

 Our thoughts are with everyone in the Philippines dealing with yet another devastating storm. Let’s hope conditions improve soon and that the floodwaters begin to recede safely.

Stay tuned for more global and local weather updates from typhoons in the Pacific to rain bands here in Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly, we’ll keep you covered 🌦️

Note though that Nov. 3 yung date sa letter but the receiving stamp says Nov. 4 – 5:11pm.

Awww bakit naman nila inatras?

Narinig ba nila ang ingay sa social media or lilipat lang sila ng venue?

Pwede naman sila sa Quirino Grandstand like last January 13, 2025 na Peace Rally.

Or pwede ulet sa Liwasang Bonifacio kung san madalas langawin ang mga DDS.

Either way, naka bantay kami sa kahit anong rally na gustong patalsikin ang gobyerno para lang maiupo ang mas masahol na pulitiko.

Abangan ang susunod na kabanata!

🚨 Typhoon Typhoon Kalmaegi (Tino) Devastates the Philippines 🌧️

The central islands reel from catastrophic flooding and powerful winds as the 20th storm of the year lashes the nation. (AP News)

🌊 Scenes of Crisis:

Entire towns submerged in Cebu and Talisay City — homes underwater, vehicles swept away. (Reuters)

At least one person dead so far, and over 150,000 evacuated across Visayas, Luzon and Mindanao.

Winds up to 150 kph (93 mph) with storm surges exceeding 3 meters foreshadowing even greater disaster. 

🚁 Relief Efforts Stalled by Tragedy:
A Philippine Air Force Super Huey helicopter crashed in Agusan del Sur during a relief mission, adding to the chaos as communities awaited crucial aid. 

🔄 Why this matters:
The Philippines battles an average of 20 storms annually. This one comes after a 6.9 magnitude quake just last month, compounding the strain on an already vulnerable system. (AP News)

🙏 Call to Action:
Our thoughts are with the people of the Philippines. Please stay safe and consider supporting verified relief efforts for those affected by the storm.

#TyphoonKalmaegi #PhilippinesFloods #ClimateEmergency

This one comes after a 6.9 magnitude quake just last month, compounding the strain on an already vulnerable system. (AP News) 🙏 Call to Action: Our thoughts are with the people of the Philippines. Please stay safe and consider supporting verified relief efforts for those affected by the storm. #TyphoonKalmaegi #PhilippinesFloods #ClimateEmergency

Typhoon Kalmaegi (Tino) claims at least 26 lives, and floods swathes of central Philippines, especially Cebu. 
#TinoPH

Hundreds of thousands displaced; many trapped on roofs as floodwaters submerge towns. 

Most died from drowning amid powerful winds and historic flooding.

And a large snake was spotted swimming amid floodwaters in Purok Maryland, Talisay City, Cebu.

Issued at: 8:00 PM, 04 November 2025(Tuesday)
